script_text: Stop right there, Cancer! Mars is squaring your Sun today, igniting tension between your ambitions and your emotional needs. You may feel pulled in two directions—work demands clashing with home life. Venus in Pisces softens relationships, offering a gentle reminder to communicate with compassion. The Moon in Scorpio urges you to dig deep—trust your intuition, even if the path feels unclear. Avoid impulsive decisions; patience is your ally. By evening, the energy shifts—Jupiter’s trine brings a glimmer of hope. Stay grounded, stay true to yourself, and let the universe guide you.
title: Cancer — Don't Ignore This
